lead_raw_text:
The structure of Co3Bi crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P-62m (No. 194), with a unit cell containing four atoms—one Bi and three Co—distributed across two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Bi centers with 12 Co neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Co centers have 9 geometric neighbors (4 Bi, 5 Co). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all four sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Co-centered 9-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Bi- and Co-centered polyhedra.
